name: HarmoCore-TCHL
summary: HarmoCore-TCHL is a lightweight harmonic joint family for humanoid robot integration. It combines a force sensor for force-position closed-loop control with integrated cables and connectors. This listing represents the series.

description.en: HarmoCore-TCHL is a lightweight harmonic joint family for humanoid robot integration. It combines a force sensor for force-position closed-loop control with integrated cables and connectors. This listing represents the series.
